lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Apply the legal requirements for who may drive a taxi and how taxiförarlegitimation is issued, carried, shown and renewed.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Requirement to hold valid taxiförarlegitimation or permitted temporary professional recognition.
Minimum age, driving licence, medical, suitability and test requirements.
Validity together with driving licence and renewal rules.
Legitimation must be carried and visible for passengers.
scenario_opportunities: A driver has valid taxiförarlegitimation but an invalid driving licence.
A driver with a foreign licence wants to drive a Swedish taxi.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Identify when taxiförarlegitimation may be revoked and distinguish revocation from warning, condition and no intervention.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Legal grounds for intervention against taxiförarlegitimation.
Warning when conditions do not justify revocation.
Olämplighetstid after serious cases.
Police/bilinspektör handling of omhändertagen legitimation.
scenario_opportunities: Repeated offences after an earlier warning.
Medical unsuitability or missing medical certificate.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Recognize and use the central definitions in taxitrafiklagen and taxitrafikförordningen.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Definition of taxitrafik.
Definition of taxiförarlegitimation.
Relationship between taxi terms and vägtrafikdefinitioner.
Examples that are not considered taxitrafik under the regulation.
scenario_opportunities: Classify whether a described transport counts as taxitrafik.
Distinguish taxi transport from private school or workplace-related transport.

lesson_outlines.lesson_title: Handlingar under färd och vid kontroll
lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Explain which documents must be carried and assess which documents must be shown at a road or vehicle control.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Taxiförarlegitimation carried in taxi traffic and shown on request.
Time book/rest-time records carried when applicable.
Proof required if driving after seized taxi registration plates with police permission.
Polismyndigheten road-control role.
scenario_opportunities: Police asks for documentation during a rest-time control.
A taxi is moved after plates have been seized.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Describe when taxitrafiktillstånd is required and what suitability, responsibility and vehicle-notification rules surround the permit.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Taxi traffic may be conducted only by someone with taxitrafiktillstånd.
Transportstyrelsen permit role and Trafikverket test role.
Yrkeskunnande, economic resources and good reputation.
Traffic responsible person and vehicle notification before use.
scenario_opportunities: A company adds vehicles before notifying Transportstyrelsen.
A permit applicant lacks enough economic resources.
calculation_opportunities: Capital and reserve requirement: 100000 SEK for first vehicle and 50000 SEK for each additional vehicle.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Apply the legal equipment rules for taxameter-equipped taxi traffic and identify when special equipment for taxi vehicles is used.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Taxi vehicles must have approved taxameter equipment or special equipment.
A taxi vehicle may not have both taxameter equipment and special equipment at the same time.
Taxameter equipment must be controlled, sealed and inspected.
Special-equipment taxi is tied to a licensed booking centre and fixed-price pre-booking flow.
Driver taxameter modes, receipts and reports require exact TSFS 2013:41 section extraction before final prose.
scenario_opportunities: An app-booked taxi has a pre-agreed price but a taxameter is present.
A vehicle has both taxameter and special equipment installed.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Apply price-information rules before and during taxi journeys, including comparison price and price quote situations.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Duty to inform passengers about the applicable tariff before the journey.
Tariff must make price assessable before and calculable after the journey.
Comparison price definition and threshold for price quote.
Price evidence must be given and preserved when required.
Detailed decal templates require exact TSFS 2013:41 section and appendix extraction before final prose.
scenario_opportunities: Determine if a binding price quote must be given before a journey.
Choose correct price-information handling for fixed price versus tariff.
calculation_opportunities: Compute comparison price for a 10 km, 15 minute journey including any start fee.
Compare the fare's comparison price to the statutory threshold.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Explain daily rest requirements and calculate whether a driver's recorded dygnsvila satisfies the rule.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Which taxi and school-transport vehicles are covered by the rest-time regulation.
Minimum 11 hours daily rest in the preceding 24-hour period.
Allowed split rest where one period is at least 8 hours.
What counts and does not count as daily rest.
Temporary deviations for unforeseeable special circumstances.
scenario_opportunities: Check whether a driver may start a shift after split rest.
Assess an accident-related deviation from normal daily rest.
calculation_opportunities: Calculate rest in a rolling 24-hour period before a planned transport.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Assess how working-time legislation affects the duties and responsibilities of drivers, employers and self-employed drivers.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Scope of road-transport working-time law.
Total working-time limits and weekly average principle.
Breaks, pauses and working-time registration.
Transportstyrelsen supervision and employer/self-employed sanctions.
Employer duties for time books and preservation of records under the rest-time regulation.
scenario_opportunities: A driver works for multiple employers.
An employer fails to preserve records or provide a time book.
calculation_opportunities: Assess average weekly working time over a reference period.
Identify prohibited overtime exposure in a simplified schedule.

lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Explain the core rules for school transport that matter to a taxi driver, including safety planning and vehicle requirements.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Definition of skolskjutsning.
Traffic-safety requirements for routes and pick-up/drop-off places.
Vehicle signage, door and seat-belt requirements.
Driver/operator penalties for vehicle-use breaches.
Basic school-law context for the right to school transport.
scenario_opportunities: Pick-up/drop-off location creates traffic-safety risk.
Vehicle used for school transport lacks required sign or door safety.

lesson_outlines.lesson_title: Sanktioner, straff och hindrande av fortsatt färd
lesson_outlines.learning_objective: Identify the main legal consequences for breaches of taxi, rest-time, working-time and school-transport rules.
facts_rules_that_need_to_be_taught: Revocation, warning and conditions for taxi permits and driver legitimacy.
Criminal penalties and hindering continued travel under taxitrafiklagen.
Rest-time regulation penalties for driver and employer.
Working-time penalties and overtime fees.
School-transport penalties for vehicle/equipment breaches.
scenario_opportunities: Choose likely consequence for a breach: warning, revocation, fine, hindering continued travel or record-control action.
Separate driver responsibility from permit-holder or employer responsibility.
calculation_opportunities: Overtime fee concept examples should be kept outline-only until full legal review.
